decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed roof extensions, would be acceptable due to their position, design and appearance. The development would not harm the appearance of the area or neighbours' living conditions and complies with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan and the Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is occupied.
description: Erection of roof extension comprising installation of pitched roof over existing two storey side extension, a rear dormer and the installation of 3 velux windows to front elevation of roof and one velux window to side elevation of roof of house.
